headline: Paranoid
caption:
UPDATE: Dana White just called Alex Pereira paranoid over his UFC conspiracy claim.
Dana or Pereira? 👇

Pereira said the UFC and Daniel Cormier steered fans toward Gane vs. Hokit. White says he has never told DC what to say, and Cormier also denied it. UFC news.

Is Poatan right to be suspicious?
question: Dana or Pereira?

v2.story: Dana says fighters are paranoid and he never tells Cormier what to say.
